newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures down sharply on cash ideas.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures down sharply on cash ideas.

text.p: Expectations of declining cash lumber prices weighed on CME lumber futures which posted sharp losses at midsession.

Futures retreated early, falling for a loss of up to $8.90 per tbf before finding support. Carryover demand from Monday's limit gains was lacking as reports cited another decline in cash spruce prices, traders said.
Private reports put cash spruce under $400 per tbf and some expectations were for cash to decline to $390 or lower soon. The botton for the seasonal break in cash is uncertain, they said.
At 1132 CDT, lumber futures posted losses of $8.40 to $2.20 per tbf with November off most at $342.50 and January off $4.70 at $355.00 per tbf.
